title: Remote Host install and switch current account

feature.title: Remote Host install and switch current account

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Confirming the Add Host follow-up must install the current active account when missing, switch the validated host, refresh remote Codex app-server state, verify the expected account, and persist verified host/account state.
Cancelling the Add Host install-current-account follow-up must leave no confusing pending or partially added remote host state.

targetSurface: CodexPill Add Host follow-up and fake remote switch workflow

nonClaims: Does not prove native Add Host or confirmation panel rendering.
Does not prove first responder focus or native click automation.
Does not exercise live SSH, live Codex app-server behavior, real remote auth mutation, or a real remote filesystem.
Does not prove remote verification failure presentation.
